ms.report:
Works and outputs:
Developed list of Plutus V2 and Aiken Cardano smart contracts that cover most popular data types (string, number and date) with basic and combined validators e.g signature, address, time and basic data.
The developed smart contracts are tested with latest Cardano Node version 9.1.0 at Conway era and published to PAAS platform at: https://paas.bworks.app/web#/contracts 
We also developed offChain code and CLI scripts to handle different data types (string, number and date) that worked with Plutus platform.
These common and combined contract validators may helpful for smart contract developers to reference or use it for their more sophisticated smart contracts. 
Some of published contracts already available for dApp developers to build dApps.

List of developed and published contracts:
Plutus V2 - Signature validator 
Plutus script to onchain validate the signature of wallet which sign unlock transaction.
The TX is validated (succeed) only if it is signed by the wallet we with public key hash attached in the datum.
GitCommit: https://github.com/bWorksApp/paas-plutus-contracts/commit/4a464749b6d0adb4255e1f94084b3641e6a6d300 
Published URL: https://paas.bworks.app/web#/contracts/66374d040da0bf446cda98c6/show 

Aiken - Signature validator
Aiken script to onchain validate the signature of wallet which sign unlock transaction.
The TX is validated (succeed) only if it is signed by the wallet with public key hash attached in the datum.
GitCommit: https://github.com/bWorksApp/paas-aiken-contracts/commit/6fd247143a069832f9368b7da80d4cc5e2664a04 
Published URL: https://paas.bworks.app/web#/contracts/669a5eaf4aec7f3b7d74e2a2/show 

Aiken V2 - Verify unlock wallet signature and secret message
Aiken script to validate the unlock transaction if below conditions are met:
It is signed by the wallet with public key hash attached in the datum.
The redeemer contains the message the same with datum secret message
GitCommit: https://github.com/bWorksApp/paas-aiken-contr
